# business_documents

Public business-source evidence returned by the service desk.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="business_documents", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="business_documents", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | object | Object value; see collection filter rules | Business-source document content; read the document as evidence rather than treating its title as the conclusion. |
| `body.accepted_units` | integer | Nested output only | Accepted units: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.assessment` | array | Nested output only | Assessment: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.bill_to_registration` | string | Nested output only | Bill to registration: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.buyer_name` | string | Nested output only | Buyer name: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.currency` | string | Nested output only | Currency code for the associated monetary fields. Preserve separate currency balances. Public values represented here: `USD`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `body.dispatched_revision` | integer | Nested output only | Dispatched revision: version of the named evidence/object. Check applicability and status along with its version. |
| `body.invoice_month` | string | Nested output only | Invoice month: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.merchant_categories` | array | Nested output only | Merchant categories: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.message_type` | string | Nested output only | Message type: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.new_issuance` | boolean | Nested output only | New issuance: true/false state flag for this record. |
| `body.ordered_units` | integer | Nested output only | Ordered units: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.payment_networks` | array | Nested output only | Payment networks: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.permitted_expenditure` | array | Nested output only | Permitted expenditure: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.principal_minor` | integer | Nested output only | Principal amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `body.purchase_orders` | array | Nested output only | Purchase orders: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.registration_regions` | array | Nested output only | Registration regions: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.release` | array | Nested output only | Release: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.request_processing_minutes` | integer | Nested output only | Request processing minutes: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `body.returned_units` | integer | Nested output only | Returned units: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.settlement_markets` | array | Nested output only | Settlement markets: list of the named business attributes or references; inspect all entries relevant to the record. |
| `body.shipment_reference` | string | Nested output only | Shipment reference: commercial reference, which may differ from the storage id. Match using the documented reference field and business context. |
| `body.supplier` | string | Nested output only | Supplier: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.transmission_status` | string | Nested output only | Transmission status: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `body.unit_price_minor` | integer | Nested output only | Unit price amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `issued_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Issued minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `issuer` | string | Top-level filter | Issuer: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `kind` | string | Top-level filter | Record or service type. Fields and meanings can differ between kinds. Public values represented here: `buyer_payment_terms`, `collection_product_terms`, `facility_covenant`, `payer_dispatch_notice`, `proceeds_assignment`, `supplier_invoice`, `warehouse_receipt`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `reference` | string | Top-level filter | Business reference on this object; its uniqueness depends on the issuer, entity and period. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `RECEIVED`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |


## Evidence and customer files

business_documents contains public source evidence; its body is searchable with a contains operator. remittance_advice contains received payer letters. service_records may itself contain source-document records; consult the service-kind dictionary before interpreting them. submissions contains actual user uploads and their target and purpose; evidence_bundles contains grouped evidence for the documented process.

Private files belong to the customer's file inventory. Only the user can call list_my_files and upload_file. Asking the customer for an identified business document does not require discovering their private file ID in the public database. Neither files nor documents is a public search_records resource. service_documents is an inherited interface without a populated public shape in this release's admitted workflow inventory; it is not the general upload store.


## Complete filter examples

Filter keys name fields. Operators are nested inside the value for a field:

```json
{"resource":"business_documents","filters":{"body":{"contains":"tax"}},"cursor":0,"limit":20}
```

```json
{"resource":"joint_agreements","filters":{"id":"<returned agreement ID>"},"cursor":0,"limit":20}
```

```json
{"resource":"joint_sources","filters":{"agreement_id":"<same returned agreement ID>"},"cursor":0,"limit":20}
```

```json
{"resource":"service_records","filters":{"case_id":"<returned service case ID>"},"cursor":0,"limit":20}
```

filters={"contains":"tax"} is not a text search: it addresses a nonexistent field named contains. Unknown scalar fields can return no matches without a schema error. An empty result remains compatible with a correct query when no accessible record matches.
